t: What Distributed Energy Resource Database Is All About
title: What Distributed Energy Resource Database Is All About
description: Distributed energy resources live at the grid's edge: rooftop solar (US: 4M+ systems), batteries, EVs, and controllable loads. IEEE 1547 governs interconnection — anti-islanding, voltage ride-through. Hosting capacity maps show where feeders can take more. Virtual power plants orchestrate DERs into grid services. The future grid is coordinated at the edge, not just commanded from the center. This database is the complete DER record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
